newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Barry Callebaut confirms Belgian merger approval.
newsitem.headline: Barry Callebaut confirms Belgian merger approval.

text.p: Barry Callebaut, the company created through a merger between cocoa firms Cacao Barry SA and Callebaut AG, has been approved by a Belgian appeals court, Barry Callebaut said in a statement.
The decision was already reported on Wednesday by a Belgian news agency.

"With great satisfaction, the business management of Barry Callebaut has taken note of the decision by the Brussels appeals court, in which the merger of Barry and Callebaut of November 25, 1996, has been approved," the company said in a statement.
Barry Callebaut is a unit of Zurich-based Klaus J Jacobs Holding.
The decision will mean that Barry Callebaut will sell a portion of the rights, and the production of Belgium-based Cacao Goemaere to Chocolaterie Jacques, it said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
